services.title: Development Process Design
services.tagline: Tools without process are just expensive toys.
services.body: We design how your team works with AI - from extracting domain knowledge to structuring agent workflows. Our domain modelers turn business expertise into AI-ready context that generic tools can't replicate.

services.title: Harness Engineering
services.tagline: The agent isn't the variable - its tools are.
services.body: We configure and optimize the complete AI development harness: tools, MCP servers, context management. A well-engineered harness gets production-quality work out of the agent you already have.

services.title: Skills Development
services.tagline: Skills are software. They need testing and measurement.
services.body: We build, test, and iterate on custom skills - from team-specific domain knowledge to universal coding patterns. We version and test them like any other software, so they keep working as your codebase and models change.

services.title: Measurement & Evaluation
services.tagline: Without measurement, every change is a guess.
services.body: Multi-dimensional evaluation on tasks from real codebases. We score architecture, code quality, tests, and team conventions on your real tasks, so you invest in the setup that is proven to work.
